# Hellenic Heritage Ticket Portal (hhticket.gr)

> > Official online ticketing platform for Greek archaeological sites and museums, including the Acropolis, Knossos, Ancient Olympia, and Delphi.

This is the Hellenic Ministry of Culture's e-ticketing system for advance booking of timed-entry tickets to Greece's most important archaeological monuments and museums. The platform offers multilingual support for booking visits to UNESCO World Heritage sites and national archaeological treasures.

## Key Topics

- Acropolis of Athens
- Knossos Palace
- Ancient Olympia
- Archaeological Museum of Delphi
- Acropolis of Lindos
- Palace of the Grand Master
- Akrotiri of Thera
- Greek archaeology
- Timed-entry tickets
- Online ticket booking
- Archaeological site access
- Parthenon
- Ancient Agora
- Museum tickets
- Greece cultural heritage

## Main Ticket Booking

- [Online Tickets for Archaeological Sites | e-tickets | Step 1](https://hhticket.gr/tap_b2c_new/english/tap.exe?PM=P1P&region=all): Main booking page for Greek archaeological sites including Acropolis & Knossos
- [Online Εισιτήρια Αρχαιολογικών Χώρων | e-tickets Ακρόπολη και Κλιτύες](https://hhticket.gr/tap_b2c_new/greek/tap.exe?PM=P1P&place=000000002): Acropolis and slopes ticket booking page with Parthenon access (Greek)
